name: Strata — Design & Agent Engineering Index
description: Curated design resources, UI libraries, AI prompt packs, security tools and agent skills for fast human browsing and native AI agent discovery. Unknown metadata is reported as unknown.

skills.name: List Categories
skills.description: Lists all categories and tracks with resource counts and metadata-governance summary.

skills.name: Filter by Category
skills.description: Returns resources for one or more categories or a full discovery track.

skills.name: Search Resources
skills.description: Weighted search over name, tags, stack, purpose and description. Supports free-mcp, archetype tags, pricing/track/type filters and limit up to 60.

skills.name: Get Resource Details
skills.description: Returns full declared metadata and provenance for one resource by id or name.
